style: Space Dominators gray-blue armored pixel art
coordinates: Image pixels. Origin top-left. Rotating heads and directional projectiles point UP at rotation 0. Enemy fighter nose points DOWN.
turretAssembly: Base at entity center. Head rotations use measured per-image pivots (mechanical joint), not bounding-box center. Same pivot map in dreadnought-config.js.

assets.description: Fixed octagonal armored mounting ring, bolts, radial joint. No barrel.
Three short fan-arranged muzzles. Cyan throat accents.
Circular magnetic accelerator with concentric rings, amber energy chamber.
Two parallel long barrels with clearly separated muzzle tips.
Compact twin missile tubes and red tracking sensor.
Five tube mouths fanning outward from one compact rotating housing, orange warning accents.
Rotating head only. Four evenly spaced radial spouts and teal armored core. Symmetric four-way silhouette. Uses the separate tur_base.
Single focusing cannon with pale magenta crystalline lens and exposed charge chamber.
Red/orange compact chevron-reticle with a bright warning dot. No text or box.
Teal four-spoke rotation glyph surrounding an unbroken small armor ring. No text or box.
Small cyan energy bead with crisp white center and a restrained 1-2 pixel halo.
Round amber energy orb, white-hot core, precise bright circular rim. Plenty of transparent margin for growth.
One slim orange-white energy bolt pointing UP, transparent padding. Render the same asset twice for twins.
Small teal-green bead, white core, clear round boundary. Different shape and color from cyan fan bolts.
Slim silver missile pointing UP, red nose sensor, tiny orange exhaust below. No long smoke trail.
One chunky dark-gold missile pointing UP, wide fins, short orange-white exhaust below. No cluster baked into image.
Thin segmented magenta telegraph stripe down vertical center, transparent surrounding area. Core 2-4 px wide, repeatable middle.
Vertical continuous white-hot laser core with magenta inner body and bounded violet outer rim. Even intensity, repeatable middle.

NEW original interstellar fighter with a spherical armored cockpit between two upright hexagonal wing panels, slim reinforced struts, dark slate armor and cyan engines. Evokes the readable twin-panel silhouette of a TIE fighter with an original panel pattern and chassis. Strict top-down view, nose DOWN. Pixel 8-bit only.

Red fleet entry warning arrow with bright exclamation mark and stepped pixel outline, transparent outside the arrow. Points DOWN at zero rotation; can be rotated toward horizontal, diagonal and side entry lanes.

waveArtContract.orientations: Rotate enemy_fighter from its native DOWN direction to follow each trajectory. Avoid regenerating inconsistent views.
waveArtContract.warning: ind_fleet_entry_red points along the announced entry trajectory. Gameplay should pulse its alpha before entry.
waveArtContract.designIntent: Moving fleet corridors deny those marked regions; the timing and layout must preserve a reachable safe region for the player.
